claim: If an alias record has Evaluate Target Health set to Yes and its alias target is a group of weighted records that all have nonzero weights, Route 53 considers the alias record healthy as long as at least one of the weighted records is healthy, and unhealthy if none of the weighted records is healthy. Route 53 stops considering records in that branch of the tree until at least one weighted record becomes healthy again.

qualifiers.scope: alias record with Evaluate Target Health set to Yes
qualifiers.condition: the weighted records all have nonzero weights

evidence.quote: As long as at least one of the weighted records is healthy, Route 53 considers the alias record to be healthy.
If none of the weighted records is healthy, Route 53 considers the alias record to be unhealthy.
You can also configure health checking for alias records by setting **Evaluate Target Health** to **Yes** for each alias record.
For example, suppose the alias target for an alias record is a group of weighted records that all have nonzero weights:
Route 53 stops considering records in that branch of the tree until at least one weighted record becomes healthy again.
